bottleneck.examplesLabel: Real-life examples of what we can do for you:

useCases.title: Quarterly fund cash flow analysis
useCases.description: A fund reports quarterly cash flows. The agent reads the PDFs, extracts figures, cross-checks the data, and updates the model in SharePoint. What took days now runs automatically.
useCases.why: The same workflow handles 5 funds or 50. Define it once, scale indefinitely.

useCases.title: Build a deck
useCases.description: Create Google Slides or PowerPoint decks from your terminal or Claude Desktop. The agent uses your company context to produce branded, consistent output.
useCases.why: Same tools, but with your company's positioning, tone, and formatting built in.

useCases.title: Client onboarding document processing
useCases.description: New clients send contracts and intake forms via Gmail. The agent extracts key fields, populates internal records in HubSpot, and flags anything missing.
useCases.why: The same workflow handles 5 clients or 500. No extra headcount needed.

useCases.title: Daily report
useCases.description: Every morning, the agent scans LinkedIn, your newsletters, X, industry feeds, and saved sources. It filters what matters to your role and delivers a personalized briefing to Slack or email.
useCases.why: Runs on a schedule. No manual searching, no missed updates.

nativeTools.title: But Aren't Claude and ChatGPT Already Adding These Features?
paragraphs: Yes, and that's exactly why this works. Tools like Claude and ChatGPT ship powerful default capabilities: skills, integrations, memory. But they're generic. Every company gets the same starting point.

ZPT takes those same building blocks and structures them around your company. Your context, your workflows, your standards. The result: your team gets more out of the tools they're already using, because the tools actually know how the company works.
